scope: Repeated player assets appearing in two or more reconstructed trade events from 2020 through 2026 Week 7.
methodology: For two-team trades, sender is inferred as the other manager in the reconstructed trade event.
For multi-team trades, sender is left ambiguous rather than guessed.
starter_points, starts, direct_edge and direct_outcome are trade-side metrics, not player-specific attribution.
This v1 traces trade-to-trade movement only. Keeper carryover, waiver reacquisition, draft origin and final roster afterlife are future lineage layers.
